title: More things built with pollinations found their way onto the project list
summary:
A community-directory day: more pollinations-powered projects, tidier model descriptions, and a few better signals about how people find things.

NailsGen, imggen.top, and WebGeniusAI joined the showcase, while the broader project list got a cleanup and DesmondBot's link was brought up to date. The garden has more paths now.

Mistral's model copy was standardized, making the available text models a little easier to compare without translating between descriptions first.

Project interactions can now carry an ad-clicked event parameter, and Draft Alpha was added to the affiliate system.
